title: Stripo Email Widgets
lede: Stripo added more than 20 prebuilt interactive email widgets, from scratch cards to NPS surveys, that marketers drop into a template and then customize by chatting with an AI assistant.

points: The set covers games such as Scratcher and Wheel of Fortune, surveys such as Poll and NPS, and content blocks such as Agenda and Event.
Each widget renders in three layers: AMP for Gmail and Yahoo, interactive HTML for Apple Mail and Samsung Email, and a static block for Outlook and other clients.
The assistant only changes content and settings; a rendering service rebuilds the HTML for all three layers after every edit.
Survey widgets collect answers inside the email itself and store them in the sender's data storage.
A finished widget can be saved as a container and reused across templates, for instance once per agency client.

sections.text: Email marketers and agencies who want interactive campaigns without hand-coding AMP or kinetic CSS and building a separate Outlook fallback.
Widgets come with every Stripo plan, including Free. The launch comment offers new users two months of the Basic plan at no cost with a promo code, card required.
